mn38:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn38:2.1: tena kho pana samayena sātissa nāma bhikkhuno kevaṭṭaputtassa evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti
mn38:2.2: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā tadevidaṃ viññāṇaṃ sandhāvati saṃsarati anaññanti.
mn38:3.2: sātissa nāma bhikkhuno kevaṭṭaputtassa evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ
mn38:3.3: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā tadevidaṃ viññāṇaṃ sandhāvati saṃsarati anaññanti.
mn38:3.4: atha kho te bhikkhū yena sāti bhikkhu kevaṭṭaputto tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā sātiṃ bhikkhuṃ kevaṭṭaputtaṃ etadavocuṃ
mn38:3.5: saccaṃ kira te āvuso sāti evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ
mn38:3.6: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā tadevidaṃ viññāṇaṃ sandhāvati saṃsarati anaññanti.
mn38:3.7: evaṃ byā kho ahaṃ āvuso bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā tadevidaṃ viññāṇaṃ sandhāvati saṃsarati anaññanti.
mn38:3.8: atha kho te bhikkhū sātiṃ bhikkhuṃ kevaṭṭaputtaṃ etasmā pāpakā diṭṭhigatā vivecetukāmā samanuyuñjanti samanuggāhanti samanubhāsanti
mn38:3.9: mā evamāvuso sāti avaca mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkha na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya
mn38:3.10: anekapariyāyena āvuso sāti paṭiccasamuppannaṃ viññāṇaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā aññatra paccayā natthi viññāṇassa sambhavoti.
mn38:3.11: evampi kho sāti bhikkhu kevaṭṭaputto tehi bhikkhūhi samanuyuñjiyamāno samanuggāhiyamāno samanubhāsiyamāno tadeva pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ thāmasā parāmassa abhinivissa voharati
mn38:3.12: evaṃ byā kho ahaṃ āvuso bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā tadevidaṃ viññāṇaṃ sandhāvati saṃsarati anaññanti.
mn38:4.1: yato kho te bhikkhū nāsakkhiṃsu sātiṃ bhikkhuṃ kevaṭṭaputtaṃ etasmā pāpakā diṭṭhigatā vivecetuṃ atha te bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ
mn38:4.2: sātissa nāma bhante bhikkhuno kevaṭṭaputtassa evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ
mn38:4.3: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā tadevidaṃ viññāṇaṃ sandhāvati saṃsarati anaññanti
mn38:4.6: atha kho mayaṃ bhante yena sāti bhikkhu kevaṭṭaputto tenupasaṅkamimha upasaṅkamitvā sātiṃ bhikkhuṃ kevaṭṭaputtaṃ etadavocumha
mn38:4.7: saccaṃ kira te āvuso sāti evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ
mn38:4.8: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā tadevidaṃ viññāṇaṃ sandhāvati saṃsarati anaññanti
mn38:4.9: evaṃ vutte bhante sāti bhikkhu kevaṭṭaputto amhe etadavoca
mn38:4.10: evaṃ byā kho ahaṃ āvuso bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā tadevidaṃ viññāṇaṃ sandhāvati saṃsarati anaññanti
mn38:4.11: atha kho mayaṃ bhante sātiṃ bhikkhu kevaṭṭaputtaṃ etasmā pāpakā diṭṭhigatā vivecetukāmā samanuyuñjimha samanuggāhimha samanubhāsimha
mn38:4.12: mā evaṃ āvuso sāti avaca mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkha na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya
mn38:4.13: anekapariyāyena āvuso sāti paṭiccasamuppannaṃ viññāṇaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā aññatra paccayā natthi viññāṇassa sambhavoti
mn38:4.14: evampi kho bhante sāti bhikkhu kevaṭṭaputto amhehi samanuyuñjiyamāno samanuggāhiyamāno samanubhāsiyamāno tadeva pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ thāmasā parāmassa abhinivissa voharati
mn38:4.15: evaṃ byā kho ahaṃ āvuso bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā tadevidaṃ viññāṇaṃ sandhāvati saṃsarati anaññanti
mn38:4.16: yato kho mayaṃ bhante nāsakkhimhā sātiṃ bhikkhuṃ kevaṭṭaputtaṃ etasmā pāpakā diṭṭhigatā vivecetuṃ atha mayaṃ etamatthaṃ bhagavato ārocemāti.
mn38:5.1: atha kho bhagavā aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi

mn38:5.4: evaṃ bhanteti kho so bhikkhu bhagavato paṭissutvā yena sāti bhikkhu kevaṭṭaputto tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā sātiṃ bhikkhuṃ kevaṭṭaputtaṃ etadavoca
mn38:5.6: evamāvusoti kho sāti bhikkhu kevaṭṭaputto tassa bhikkhuno paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho sātiṃ bhikkhuṃ kevaṭṭaputtaṃ bhagavā etadavoca
mn38:5.7: saccaṃ kira te sāti evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ
mn38:5.8: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā tadevidaṃ viññāṇaṃ sandhāvati saṃsarati anaññanti.
mn38:5.9: evaṃ byā kho ahaṃ bhante bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā tadevidaṃ viññāṇaṃ sandhāvati saṃsarati anaññanti.
mn38:5.11: yvāyaṃ bhante vado vedeyyo tatra tatra kalyāṇapāpakānaṃ kammānaṃ vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedetīti.
mn38:5.12: kassa nu kho nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa mayā evaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāsi
mn38:5.13: nanu mayā moghapurisa anekapariyāyena paṭiccasamuppannaṃ viññāṇaṃ vuttaṃ aññatra paccayā natthi viññāṇassa sambhavoti
mn38:5.14: atha ca pana tvaṃ moghapurisa attanā duggahitena amhe ceva abbhācikkhasi attānañca khanasi bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavasi
mn38:5.15: tañhi te moghapurisa bhavissati dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyāti.
mn38:6.3: apināyaṃ sāti bhikkhu kevaṭṭaputto usmīkatopi imasmiṃ dhammavinayeti.
mn38:6.6: evaṃ vutte sāti bhikkhu kevaṭṭaputto tuṇhībhūto maṅkubhūto pattakkhandho adhomukho pajjhāyanto appaṭibhāṇo nisīdi.
mn38:6.7: atha kho bhagavā sātiṃ bhikkhuṃ kevaṭṭaputtaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ maṅkubhūtaṃ pattakkhandhaṃ adhomukhaṃ pajjhāyantaṃ appaṭibhāṇaṃ viditvā sātiṃ bhikkhuṃ kevaṭṭaputtaṃ etadavoca
mn38:6.8: paññāyissasi kho tvaṃ moghapurisa etena sakena pāpakena diṭṭhigatena
mn38:7.2: tumhepi me bhikkhave evaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānātha yathāyaṃ sāti bhikkhu kevaṭṭaputto attanā duggahitena amhe ceva abbhācikkhati attānañca khanati bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavatīti.
mn38:7.4: anekapariyāyena hi no bhante paṭiccasamuppannaṃ viññāṇaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā aññatra paccayā natthi viññāṇassa sambhavoti.
mn38:7.6: sādhu kho me tumhe bhikkhave evaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānātha
mn38:7.7: anekapariyāyena hi bhikkhave paṭiccasamuppannaṃ vuttaṃ mayā aññatra paccayā natthi viññāṇassa sambhavoti
mn38:7.8: atha ca panāyaṃ sāti bhikkhu kevaṭṭaputto attanā duggahitena amhe ceva abbhācikkhati attānañca khanati bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavati
mn38:7.9: tañhi tassa moghapurisassa bhavissati dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya.

mn38:23.1: api nu tumhe bhikkhave evaṃ jānantā evaṃ passantā pubbantaṃ vā paṭidhāveyyātha
mn38:23.2: ahesumhā nu kho mayaṃ atītamaddhānaṃ na nu kho ahesumhā atītamaddhānaṃ kiṃ nu kho ahesumhā atītamaddhānaṃ kathaṃ nu kho ahesumhā atītamaddhānaṃ kiṃ hutvā kiṃ ahesumhā nu kho mayaṃ atītamaddhānanti.
mn38:23.4: api nu tumhe bhikkhave evaṃ jānantā evaṃ passantā aparantaṃ vā paṭidhāveyyātha
mn38:23.5: bhavissāma nu kho mayaṃ anāgatamaddhānaṃ na nu kho bhavissāma anāgatamaddhānaṃ kiṃ nu kho bhavissāma anāgatamaddhānaṃ kathaṃ nu kho bhavissāma anāgatamaddhānaṃ kiṃ hutvā kiṃ bhavissāma nu kho mayaṃ anāgatamaddhānanti.
mn38:24.1: api nu tumhe bhikkhave evaṃ jānantā evaṃ passantā etarahi vā paccuppannaddhānaṃ ārabbha ajjhattaṃ kathaṃkathittha
mn38:24.2: ahaṃ nu khosmi no nu khosmi kinnu khosmi kathaṃ nu khosmi ayaṃ nu kho satto kuto āgato so kuhiṅgāmī bhavissatīti.
mn38:24.4: api nu tumhe bhikkhave evaṃ jānantā evaṃ passantā evaṃ vadeyyātha
mn38:24.5: satthā no garu satthu gāraveneva mayaṃ evaṃ vadeyyāmāti.
mn38:24.7: api nu tumhe bhikkhave evaṃ jānantā evaṃ passantā evaṃ vadeyyātha
mn38:24.8: samaṇo evamāha samaṇā ca na ca mayaṃ evaṃ vademāti.
mn38:24.10: api nu tumhe bhikkhave evaṃ jānantā evaṃ passantā aññaṃ satthāraṃ uddiseyyāthāti.
mn38:24.12: api nu tumhe bhikkhave evaṃ jānantā evaṃ passantā yāni tāni puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ vatta kotūhala maṅgalāni tāni sārato paccāgaccheyyāthāti.
mn38:24.14: nanu bhikkhave yadeva tumhākaṃ sāmaṃ ñātaṃ sāmaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sāmaṃ viditaṃ tadeva tumhe vadeyyāthāti.
mn38:25.1: sādhu bhikkhave upanītā kho me tumhe bhikkhave iminā sandiṭṭhikena dhammena akālikena ehipassikena opanayikena paccattaṃ veditabbena viññūhi
mn38:25.2: sandiṭṭhiko ayaṃ bhikkhave dhammo akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti
mn38:25.3: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn38:26.1: tiṇṇaṃ kho pana bhikkhave sannipātā gabbhassāvakkanti hoti.
mn38:26.2: idha mātāpitaro ca sannipatitā honti mātā ca na utunī hoti gandhabbo ca na paccupaṭṭhito hoti neva tāva gabbhassāvakkanti hoti.
mn38:26.3: idha mātāpitaro ca sannipatitā honti mātā ca utunī hoti gandhabbo ca na paccupaṭṭhito hoti neva tāva gabbhassāvakkanti hoti.
mn38:26.4: yato ca kho bhikkhave mātāpitaro ca sannipatitā honti mātā ca utunī hoti gandhabbo ca paccupaṭṭhito hoti evaṃ tiṇṇaṃ sannipātā gabbhassāvakkanti hoti.
mn38:27.1: tamenaṃ bhikkhave mātā nava vā dasa vā māse gabbhaṃ kucchinā pariharati mahatā saṃsayena garubhāraṃ
mn38:27.2: tamenaṃ bhikkhave mātā navannaṃ vā dasannaṃ vā māsānaṃ accayena vijāyati mahatā saṃsayena garubhāraṃ
mn38:27.3: tamenaṃ jātaṃ samānaṃ sakena lohitena posesi.
mn38:27.4: lohitañhetaṃ bhikkhave ariyassa vinaye yadidaṃ mātu thaññaṃ.
mn38:28.1: sa kho so bhikkhave kumāro vuḍḍhimanvāya indriyānaṃ paripākamanvāya

mn38:29.1: sa kho so bhikkhave kumāro vuḍḍhimanvāya indriyānaṃ paripākamanvāya
mn38:29.3: cakkhuviññeyyehi rūpehi iṭṭhehi kantehi manāpehi piyarūpehi kāmūpasañhitehi rajanīyehi pemanīyehi
mn38:29.7: kāyaviññeyyehi phoṭṭhabbehi iṭṭhehi kantehi manāpehi piyarūpehi kāmūpasañhitehi rajanīyehi pemanīyehi.
mn38:30.1: so cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe sārajjati appiyarūpe rūpe byāpajjati anupaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati parittacetaso
mn38:30.2: tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti yatthassa te pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti.
mn38:30.3: so evaṃ anurodhavirodhaṃ samāpanno yaṅkiñci vedanaṃ vedeti sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā. so taṃ vedanaṃ abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
mn38:30.4: tassa taṃ vedanaṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandi
mn38:30.5: yā vedanāsu nandi tadupādānaṃ tassa upādānapaccayā bhavo bhavapaccayā jāti jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ soka parideva dukkhadomanassu pāyāsā sambhavanti
mn38:30.11: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya piyarūpe dhamme sārajjati appiyarūpe dhamme byāpajjati anupaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati parittacetaso
mn38:30.12: tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti yatthassa te pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti.
mn38:30.13: so evaṃ anurodhavirodhaṃ samāpanno yaṅkiñci vedanaṃ vedeti sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā. so taṃ vedanaṃ abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
mn38:30.14: tassa taṃ vedanaṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandi
mn38:30.15: yā vedanāsu nandi tadupādānaṃ tassa upādānapaccayā bhavo bhavapaccayā jāti jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ soka parideva dukkha domanassu pāyāsā sambhavanti
mn38:31.1: idha bhikkhave tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā
mn38:31.2: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti
mn38:31.3: so dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ
mn38:32.1: taṃ dhammaṃ suṇāti gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aññatarasmiṃ vā kule pacchā jāto.
mn38:32.2: so taṃ dhammaṃ sutvā tathāgate saddhaṃ paṭilabhati.
mn38:32.3: so tena saddhāpaṭilābhena samannāgato iti paṭisañcikkhati
mn38:32.5: nayidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ
mn38:32.6: yannūnāhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyyanti.
mn38:32.7: so aparena samayena appaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya mahantaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya appaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya mahantaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati.
mn38:33.1: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī dayāpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī viharati.
mn38:33.2: adinnādānaṃ pahāya adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti dinnādāyī dinnapāṭikaṅkhī athenena sucibhūtena attanā viharati.
mn38:33.3: abrahmacariyaṃ pahāya brahmacārī hoti ārācārī virato methunā gāmadhammā.
mn38:33.4: musāvādaṃ pahāya musāvādā paṭivirato hoti saccavādī saccasandho ṭheto paccayiko avisaṃvādako lokassa.
mn38:33.5: pisuṇaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti ito sutvā na amutra akkhātā imesaṃ bhedāya amutra vā sutvā na imesaṃ akkhātā amūsaṃ bhedāya iti bhinnānaṃ vā sandhātā sahitānaṃ vā anuppadātā samaggārāmo samaggarato samagganandī samaggakaraṇiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.
mn38:33.6: pharusaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti yā sā vācā nelā kaṇṇasukhā pemanīyā hadayaṅgamā porī bahujanakantā bahujanamanāpā tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.
mn38:33.7: samphappalāpaṃ pahāya samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti kālavādī bhūtavādī atthavādī dhammavādī vinayavādī nidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti kālena sāpadesaṃ pariyantavatiṃ atthasañhitaṃ.
mn38:33.10: nacca gīta vādita visūkadassanā paṭivirato hoti.
mn38:33.11: mālā gandha vilepanadhāraṇa maṇḍanavibhūsanaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti.
mn38:33.18: khetta vatthupaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti. aje ḷakapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti.
mn38:33.25: ukkoṭana vañcana nikati sāviyogā paṭivirato hoti.
mn38:33.26: chedana vadhabandhana viparāmosa ālopa sahasākārā paṭivirato hoti.
mn38:34.1: so santuṭṭho hoti kāyaparihārikena cīvarena kucchiparihārikena piṇḍapātena yena yeneva pakkamati samādāyeva pakkamati.
mn38:34.2: seyyathāpi nāma pakkhī sakuṇo yena yeneva ḍeti sapattabhārova ḍeti
mn38:34.3: evameva bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti kāyaparihārikena cīvarena kucchiparihārikena piṇḍapātena yena yeneva pakkamati samādāyeva pakkamati.
mn38:34.4: so iminā ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ anavajjasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
mn38:35.1: so cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī
mn38:35.2: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
mn38:35.7: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī
mn38:35.8: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati rakkhati manindriyaṃ manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
mn38:35.9: so iminā ariyena indriyasaṃvarena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ abyāsekasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
mn38:36.1: so abhikkante paṭikkante sampajānakārī hoti ālokite vilokite sampajānakārī hoti sammiñjite pasārite sampajānakārī hoti saṅghāṭi patta cīvaradhāraṇe sampajānakārī hoti asite pīte khāyite sāyite sampajānakārī hoti uccāra passāvakamme sampajānakārī hoti gate ṭhite nisinne sutte jāgarite bhāsite tuṇhībhāve sampajānakārī hoti.
mn38:37.1: so iminā ca ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato iminā ca ariyena indriyasaṃvarena samannāgato iminā ca ariyena satisampajaññena samannāgato
mn38:37.2: vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ.
mn38:38.1: so pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
mn38:38.2: so abhijjhaṃ loke pahāya vigatābhijjhena cetasā viharati abhijjhāya cittaṃ parisodheti.
mn38:38.3: byāpādapadosaṃ pahāya abyāpannacitto viharati sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī byāpādapadosā cittaṃ parisodheti.
mn38:38.4: thīnamiddhaṃ pahāya vigatathīnamiddho viharati ālokasaññī sato sampajāno thīnamiddhā cittaṃ parisodheti.
